$comment: MCP client registration for the TestRail bridge.
- .mcp.json          at the repo root   (Claude Code / Cowork)
Paths are relative to the repo root, so register it from there.
No credentials belong in this file. The bridge reads
engine/mcp/testrail/.env from its own directory, which keeps the secret out
of a config file that is easy to commit by accident.
The tool list is built at startup, so restart the client after changing
TESTRAIL_MODE or TESTRAIL_ALLOW_DELETE - otherwise the new tools will not
